intent: Unblock the shared branch by applying prettier to endurain/README.md, which was committed unformatted by another agent and fails the pre-push prettier hook for everyone pushing after it.
scope: Non-goal: any content change; this file belongs to another agent's feature
changes: Ran the repo's prettier over endurain/README.md, reflowing 9 lines

verification.command: npx prettier --check on every markdown/json/yaml file in the push range
verification.evidence: Only endurain/README.md was flagged; my own files and the other agent's json/yml were already clean.
9 insertions, 9 deletions -- pure reflow, no content added or removed.

risks: The file belongs to another agent's in-flight feature; a formatting-only change could conflict with their next edit, though prettier output is deterministic so a re-run converges.
rollback: git revert the commit; the pre-push prettier hook will then block pushes again until it is reformatted
